title: Pricing catalog consolidation: canonical release notes, entitlement cutover, and launch sequencing
creator: Mateo Ruiz
description: Goal: Coordinate a cross-functional launch for the pricing/catalog consolidation that replaces the legacy SKU matrix with the new consolidated catalog. Deliverables include: a canonical set of release notes and changelog snippets for public docs, a validated entitlement mapping and per-customer migration plan, QA-signed billing invoices for test customers, and a staged sales enablement rollout. This ticket owns sequencing, dependencies, and the canonical communications artifacts used by Support, Sales, and Docs.
milestones: M2: Entitlement mapping spreadsheet validated with top-50 customers (2026-03-08)
M4: Release notes canonicalized and localized (2026-03-16)
M5: Sales enablement workshop + playbooks distributed (2026-03-18)
launch_comm_plan: Create canonical release notes doc (single-source-of-truth) in Confluence; Docs will pull snippet fragments for product docs and API changelog.
Prepare customer-facing announcement email templates segmented by entitlement type (free, startup, enterprise).
Coordinate Support switchover guide and canned responses for top-10 expected questions.
Schedule staged pilot notifications to 10 pilot customers and two internal dogfood tenants.
Set social + blog embargo timings with comms team; ensure legal signoff on pricing phrasing.
release_notes_tasks: Write canonical summary paragraph (what changed, why, effective date).
Create per-SKU bullets with migration notes and examples (token math, limits).
Add API compatibility notes and sample curl requests for new SKU fields.
Generate localized short summaries for EU and APAC markets (Docs owner: Rina).
Tag release notes with product and billing release IDs and include rollback instructions.
sales_enablement_tasks: Run two 60-minute enablement workshops for Sales + SEs (record and circulate).
Build one-pager: differences vs legacy SKUs, savings examples for common usage patterns.
Create objection handler doc for price-sensitive customers and migration discount rules.
Update pricing calculator with new SKU names and limits; publish embedded iframe for AE portal.
Prepare enterprise migration checklist and per-account entitlements export for CSMs.
engineering_tasks: Feature flag behind tenant -> new_catalog_enabled for staged rollout.
API: add fields billing.sku_id and plan_limits; maintain backward-compatible aliases.
Implement entitlement migration job with dry-run mode and audit logs.
Add end-to-end tests covering billing events, invoice generation, and quota enforcement.
Performance test: ensure limit checks add <3ms p95 request latency under typical workloads.
billing_tasks: Provision billing sandbox tenants and seed historic metering data for reconciliation.
Run reconciliation across last 3 months for 5 representative tenants and compare invoices.
Create test invoices and verification checklist for Finance signoff.
Coordinate with external payment gateway for SKU name mapping and reporting exports.
Finalize entitlements export format for entitlement-migration job and Support tools.
risks_mitigations: Risk: Incorrect entitlement mapping causes overcharge. Mitigation: mandatory dry-run + manual signoff for top-50 customers before cutover.
Risk: Release notes ambiguous leading to increased Support volume. Mitigation: canonical FAQ and two internal office-hours sessions for Support and Sales.
Risk: Billing integration edge-cases for legacy invoices. Mitigation: holdback period where legacy and new invoices are both available and Finance performs reconciliation.
Risk: Legal/regulatory phrasing triggers review delay. Mitigation: early review with Legal (Anya) and maintain approved phrase library.

2026-03-17 to 2026-03-20: Sales enablement workshops, support office hours, and final signoffs.
